home.hero_subtitle: Discover breathtaking landscapes and unforgettable experiences with Rio Sur Adventure.
home.featured_promotion_description: We have new adventure packages that include lodging, transfers, and unforgettable experiences. Don't miss out!

services.title: Our Adventure Services
services.description: We offer a variety of tours and activities for all skill levels. Every experience is designed to be safe, thrilling, and memorable. Plus, to recharge your energy, all our services include a complimentary snack!
services.hiking_description: Embark on an adventure where every step connects you with pure nature. You will ascend through native forests and dreamlike viewpoints while enjoying a snack that recharges your energy to continue exploring. Feel the mountain breathe with you and let yourself be carried away by its untamed magic!
services.biking_title: Bike Rental: Your Adventure, Your Pace
services.biking_description: Feel the wind on your face and the freedom to explore Panguipulli on two wheels! Our high-end mountain bikes are your passport to adventure. Design your own journey, with no guides or fixed schedules. We provide the gear, you choose the path. Ready to pedal into the unknown?
services.rafting_title: Whitewater Rafting: Conquer the Wild Rivers!
services.rafting_description: Southern Chile is a paradise for rafting, with rivers born from the Andes that carve their way through volcanic landscapes and lush forests. It's not just a sport; it's a pact with nature. Feel the power of the water beneath your raft, paddle as a team, and celebrate every rapid as a victory. Prepare your senses for a pure dose of adrenaline in the veins of Patagonia. The river is calling!
services.horseback_riding_description: Discover freedom at a gallop, riding through landscapes that seem taken from a dream. After a day of connection with nature and local tradition, enjoy a rustic barbecue outdoors that awakens the senses and celebrates life. An unforgettable day of laughter, fire, and friendship!
services.lake_expedition_description: Float on crystal-clear waters surrounded by mountains that reflect like mirrors. Every paddle stroke is a caress to the soul, every wave a moment of freedom. Dare to glide across the lake and discover the perfect balance between adventure, calm, and wonder!
services.hot_springs_description: Picture this: after a day of adventure, you immerse yourself in waters flowing from the heart of the earth, surrounded by ancient forests and the pure Patagonian air. In the Lakes Region, every hot spring is a sanctuary. We invite you to disconnect from the world and reconnect with yourself in steaming pools under a starry sky. It's not just relaxation; it's therapy for the body and soul that only southern Chile can offer. Let yourself be embraced by the volcanic magic of Panguipulli!
services.canopy_title: Canopy: Fly Over the Heart of the Forest!
services.canopy_description: Ready to fly? Glide at full speed above the treetops, feeling the pure adrenaline and seeing the world from a bird's-eye view. This is your chance to be free, safe, and surrounded by nature. Dare to conquer the Patagonian sky!
services.night_tourism_title: 🔥 DARE TO EXPERIENCE “DARK TOURISM” IN PANGUIPULLI 🔥
services.night_tourism_description: 💀 This isn't just a tour… it's an experience that will make you feel alive. 💀 Do you dare to cross the border between the real and the unknown? At Río Sur Adventure, we invite you to a nocturnal journey where adrenaline, mystery, and the supernatural blend with the magic of southern Chile.
services.downtown_tour_description: Discover the soul of Panguipulli on a journey that goes beyond the tourist trail. Let yourself be guided by the stories its streets hold, meet the artisans who bring wood and wool to life, and savor the local culture in every corner. It's an immersion into the identity of a town that lives to the rhythm of its lakes and volcanoes.
services.kayaking_description: Become one with the water as you glide on your Stand Up Paddle board across lakes of infinite calm. Explore secret bays, get close to local birdlife, and feel the deep peace that only silence and the gentle murmur of the water can offer. It is a meditation in motion, and it also includes a snack to recharge your energy!

hiking.title: CONQUER THE SUMMIT: Hiking Expeditions
hiking.description: This isn't a walk in the park. It's a challenge against gravity, a dialogue with rock and wind. We will guide you along trails that rise to the sky, where the air is purer and the reward is views that humble maps.

options.title: Mountain Baptism: Ascent to Filcumpulli
options.description: Start your legend here. Conquer the Filcumpulli viewpoint and get a 360° view of volcanoes and lakes. It's the first great achievement of your journey, perfect for awakening the adventurous spirit.

options.title: Olympus Ascent: Mocho-Choshuenco Volcano
options.description: For those who do not fear fatigue and seek glory. An epic journey to the roof of the region. Up there, only the wind, silence, and an ocean of peaks at your feet. It requires courage.

options.title: The Secret of the Forest: Trail of the Spirits
options.description: Walk where magic is real. A journey through waterfalls and mystical sculptures that whisper ancient stories. It's not just walking; it's feeling the energy of the Mapuche land.

hiking.safety_description: The mountain demands respect, and we give it. Our guides are WFR-certified guardians, equipped for any eventuality. Before each ascent, we conduct a safety oath. We leave nothing to chance. Your only concern will be to put one foot in front of the other.

lake_expedition.title: ODYSSEY OF THE 7 LAKES: Epic Journey through Ancestral Waters
lake_expedition.description: This isn't a tour; it's a saga. A total immersion into the scenic route that brings worldwide fame to this land. Feel the immensity of the Andes reflected in seven legendary mirrors of water. You will navigate, explore, and conquer each one, discovering its secret beaches, its silent islands, and the unique energy that emanates from its depths. It is a journey to the origin, to the liquid heart of Patagonia. Prepare for an experience that will redefine your concept of landscape.
lake_expedition.options_title: THE 7 RINGS OF WATER: The Heart of the Route

options.title: Panguipulli Lake: The Spirit of the Puma
options.description: The host. Its waters guard the city and reflect the Choshuenco volcano. It's the starting point, where the energy of the 'land of pumas' welcomes you.

options.title: Calafquén Lake: The Other Lake
options.description: A paradise of beaches and picturesque towns. Its shared waters between Panguipulli and Villarrica are famous for their warmth and life-filled corners.

options.title: Riñihue Lake: The Place of the Colihue
options.description: The quiet giant. The last great lake of the circuit, whose powerful waters shaped history with the 'Riñihuazo'. Today, it's a haven of peace and imposing nature.

options.title: Pirihueico Lake: Puddle of Snow
options.description: The wildest and most untamed. A freshwater fjord encased between forested mountains that transports you to another era. Crossing it by ferry is an experience in itself.

options.title: Neltume Lake: The Rebel Soul
options.description: Small in size, but giant in beauty and character. A lake of restless waters surrounded by the Valdivian jungle in its maximum expression.

options.title: Pellaifa Lake: Frost of the Frost
options.description: The calm twin of Calafquén. A sanctuary for bird watching and connecting with the most serene nature, ideal for a break on a SUP or kayak.

options.title: Pullinque Lake: Eyes of the Devil
options.description: The most mysterious. A lake intervened by the hand of man but which has not lost its charm. Its dark waters hide legends and reflect a breathtaking landscape.

lake_expedition.note: The cost of the trip may vary depending on the distance from our operations center in Panguipulli and the selected boats.
lake_expedition.safety_description: In these waters, you are part of the crew. Our guides are admirals of Patagonia, experts in rescue and meteorology. We equip you with the best and train you to be an autonomous explorer. Your safety is the compass that guides every paddle.

hot_springs.title: REBIRTH IN THE VOLCANO: Immersion in Millennial Hot Springs
hot_springs.description: This is not a spa. It's a ritual. Immerse yourself in waters born from the burning heart of the earth, loaded with minerals and volcanic energy. Let the heat embrace your tired muscles and the steam cleanse your soul. Surrounded by silent forests and the murmur of water, you will feel the outside world fade away. You will leave renewed, reborn, ready for the next battle.
hot_springs.options_title: Choose your Sanctuary of Fire and Water

options.title: The Zen Labyrinth: Geometric Hot Springs
options.description: An architectural masterpiece in the middle of nowhere. Walk along red footbridges suspended over a steaming stream and find your perfect pool. It's a surreal and profoundly healing experience.

options.title: The Wild Luxury: Huilo Huilo Hot Springs
options.description: The perfect harmony between the comfort of a resort and the untamed beauty of the Patagonian jungle. Relax in style after a day of intense exploration.

options.title: The Origin: Vergara and El Rincón Hot Springs
options.description: For purists. Rustic pools, healing mud, and the sound of the river as the only soundtrack. It is the thermal experience in its rawest and most authentic state.

downtown_tour.title: THE SOUL OF PANGUIPULLI: A Journey into Local Culture
downtown_tour.description: Anyone can take a picture. Few can capture the soul of a place. We will take you beyond the postcards, to the streets where the heart of Panguipulli beats. You will meet the artisans who make the wood speak, you will hear the legends hidden in its walls, and you will taste the authentic flavors that do not appear in the tourist guides. It is not a tour, it is a cultural immersion.
attractions: Casona Cultural: The epicenter of local art.
Panguipulli Pier: Where the lake tells its stories.
San Sebastián Church: Architecture that defies time.
Artisans' Fair: The place to find unique treasures.
Chocolate Factory: The sweet taste of Patagonia.
Cerro Pitrén Viewpoint: The city at your feet.
Beer Route: The artisanal flavor of the area.

rafting.title: DOMINATE THE RIVER: Whitewater Rafting Battle
rafting.description: Forget about calm rides. This is a war against the fury of the river. You will feel the roar of the water, the crashing of the waves against the raft, and pure adrenaline pumping through your veins. Paddle as if your life depends on it, because it will. Work as a team, shout, laugh, and fight. You will leave the river a different person: stronger, braver, a true conqueror of whitewater.

options.title: Fuy River: Turquoise Adrenaline
options.description: Navigate the famous turquoise waters of the Fuy, a world-class river that will challenge you with intense rapids and technical runs. You'll flow through spectacular canyons, surrounded by the Valdivian rainforest. It's the crown jewel of rafting in the region, ideal for adventurers looking to take their excitement to the next level.

options.title: San Pedro River: The Family Adventure
options.description: Perfect for beginners or a family adventure. The San Pedro offers a thrilling journey with friendly rapids and pools for swimming and playing. It's a scenic and fun trip, where teamwork combines with the breathtaking beauty of the lake landscape. Laughter and mild adrenaline guaranteed!

options.title: Enco River: The Hidden Corridor
options.description: A hidden treasure connecting the Panguipulli and Riñihue lakes. The Enco offers a more intimate and wild rafting experience, with surprising rapids and privileged views of the volcanoes. It's a route for those looking to explore less-traveled places and feel a deep connection with the environment.

rafting.safety_title: In the Fury of the Water, We Are Your Shield
rafting.safety_description: The chaos of the river is our playground. Each guide is a whitewater general, certified by the IRF and accompanied by elite kayakers who are your shadow in the water. The equipment is military-grade, the safety talk is a survival manifesto. Here, safety is not a promise, it is an obsession.

biking.title: CHART YOUR OWN MAP: Mountain Bike Adventure
biking.description: Asphalt is for tourists. We prefer dust and mud. We give you a two-wheeled war machine and a map full of possibilities. The rest is up to you. Feel the burn in your legs as you climb forgotten trails and the pure speed on descents that will test your courage. This is not a ride. It is the freedom to conquer the land at your own pace.

options.title: Lake Route: Scenic Beauty
options.description: A route to enjoy the landscape without your legs hating you the next day. Panoramic views, secret beaches, and the lake breeze on your face.

options.title: The Titan's Challenge: Calafquén Lake Loop
options.description: A one-day marathon for cyclists forged in steel. Asphalt, gravel, hellish climbs, and dizzying descents. Completing it is a badge of honor.

canopy.title: FLY OVER THE END OF THE WORLD: Adrenaline on the Canopy
canopy.description: Afraid of heights? Perfect! The canopy is not for flying, it's for conquering vertigo. Launch yourself into the void and fly like a condor over the forest canopy, with your heart in your throat and a view that will take your breath away. It is a dose of pure adrenaline, an injection of freedom that will leave you trembling with emotion. You will not only see the forest, you will dominate it from the sky.
canopy.safety_description: Fly with complete confidence. We use state-of-the-art, internationally certified equipment (harnesses, helmets, pulleys, and carabiners). Our guides are experts trained in canopy operation and high-altitude rescue techniques. Before each flight, you will receive a detailed instructional briefing so that your only concern is to enjoy the ride.

night_tourism.title: 🔥 DARE TO EXPERIENCE 'DARK TOURISM' IN PANGUIPULLI 🔥
night_tourism.description: This is not a simple tour; it's an experience that will make you feel alive. Do you dare to cross the border between the real and the unknown? At Río Sur Adventure, we invite you to a nocturnal journey where adrenaline, mystery, and the supernatural blend with the magic of southern Chile. Dark forests, cemeteries under the stars, skin-crawling stories, and bonfires that hide ancient secrets. Get ready to live a night you will never forget.

options.title: 👻 Horror stories and bonfire
options.description: When the sun goes down and the shadows lengthen, the fire is lit... and with it, the stories you'll never want to hear alone.

options.title: 🏹 Symbolic hunt
options.description: Feel the tension in the air, the sounds of the forest, and that feeling that... something is watching you.

options.title: 🌌 Stargazing in the cemetery
options.description: A moment of connection between the earthly and the eternal, where silence finds a voice.

options.title: 🌫️ Paranormal experiences in the Panguipulli forest
options.description: The inexplicable takes shape in the mist... do you dare to look?

options.title: 🕯️ Enigmatic stories
options.description: Real accounts, unsolved mysteries, souls that still roam the paths of the south.

night_tourism.safety_title: And to end the night... A huge party on the beach!
night_tourism.safety_description:
Under the moon, with good music, fire, and drinks, you'll celebrate surviving a unique experience.

💥 It's not for everyone. It's for those who seek to feel, to vibrate, and to challenge the unknown.

🌑 Dark Tourism Panguipulli – Where the brave meet.

horseback_riding.title: GALLOP TO FREEDOM: Horseback Expedition
horseback_riding.description: This is not a pony ride. It's feeling the power of a noble beast under your control, galloping through open meadows with the wind in your face and the Andes as a backdrop. You are a pioneer, an explorer, reconquering Patagonia at a gallop. At the end of the day, the smell of leather and sweat will mix with that of the fire, as we share a country-style barbecue under the stars. This is freedom in its purest state.

kayaking.title: LAKE SECRETS: Mystical Journey on SUP & Kayak
kayaking.description: The lake has secrets, and it only reveals them to those who approach in silence. Glide over a mirror of water, where the only sound is your paddle cutting the surface. Explore deserted islands, beaches no one else can reach, and bays where nature remains untouched. It's not an exercise, it's a moving meditation, a deep connection with the aquatic soul of Panguipulli. Includes a snack to recharge the body, because the spirit will already be full.

about.title: About Rio Sur Adventure
about.mission_text: At Río Sur Adventure, we are dedicated to creating authentic tourist experiences that connect people with the nature, culture, and energy of southern Chile. Our mission is to provide safe, sustainable, and memorable adventures, guided by respect for the environment, love for Panguipulli, and a passion for sharing its unique beauty with the world.
about.vision_text: To be the leading travel agency in southern Chile, recognized for inspiring travelers from all over to discover the magic of the Seven Lakes territory, promoting responsible tourism that protects and values the natural and cultural riches of our region.
about.why_choose_us_text: Because at Río Sur Adventure, we don't just offer tours: we create memories. Our local guides are expert connoisseurs of the environment, passionate about adventure, and committed to your safety and well-being. We stand out for offering personalized, sustainable, and authentic experiences, where each trip becomes a story you'll want to live again.
about.panguipulli_magic_text: In the heart of southern Chile, where the forests converse with the lakes and the volcanoes watch from a distance, lies Panguipulli, “land of pumas” in the Mapuche language. Founded on the shores of the lake of the same name, this city flourishes between crystal-clear waters and mist-covered mountains. In ancient times, the native peoples saw this place as a sacred portal between the earth and the spirits of the forest. Today, that same energy is breathed in every corner: in the sound of the wind among the coigües, in the warmth of its people, and in the adventures that await those who dare to explore its magic.
